waistbandPosition.name: Waistband position (%)
waistbandPosition.help: Controls the position of the waistband.

waistbandShape.name: Waistband shape
waistbandShape.help: Whether you want a straight or shaped waistband.

waistbandWidth.name: Waistband width (%)
waistbandWidth.help: Controls the width of the waistband.

lengthBonus.name: Length bonus (%)
lengthBonus.help: Determines how long the skirt will be.

circleRatio.name: Circle ratio (%)
circleRatio.help: The percentage of a circle you want the skirt to be.

waistbandOverlap.name: Waistband overlap (%)
waistbandOverlap.help: The amount by which the waistband overlaps.

gathering.name: Gathering (%)
gathering.help: The percent by which the top of the skirt is longer than the bottom of the waistband.

seamlessFullCircle.name: Seamless full circle
seamlessFullCircle.help: Enables a seamless full circle skirt.
